name: Hierarchical Digital Differential Analyzer (HDDA)
definition: A specialized algorithm that performs multi-resolution leapfrogging at the various levels of the VDB structure, taking full advantage of the underlying B+tree structure of VDB to efficiently determine voxels or tiles intersected by a given ray.
summary: HDDA is a ray traversal algorithm for sparse voxel grids that uses multi-resolution leapfrogging to efficiently skip empty space, unlike standard DDA which steps voxel-by-voxel.
